source.author: verg
source.text: Nocte leves melius stipulae, nocte arida prata tondentur, noctes lentus non deficit humor.
source.text_original: Nocte leves melius stipulae, nocte arida prata / tondentur, noctes lentus non deficit humor.
source.text_english: At night the light stubble is better mown, at night the dry meadows are cut, at night the sluggish moisture does not fail.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: luna quoque nocturni temporis gubernatrix amissi ac recepti luminis uicibus menstrua spatia moderatur et caecas tenebris horrentibus noctes fulgore suae claritatis illustrat, ut aestiua itinera et expeditiones et opera sine labore ac molestia confici possint, siquidem nocte leues melius stipulae, nocte arida prata tondentur .
reuse.text_original: luna quoque nocturni temporis gubernatrix amissi ac recepti luminis uicibus menstrua spatia moderatur et caecas tenebris horrentibus noctes fulgore suae claritatis illustrat, ut aestiua itinera et expeditiones et opera sine labore ac molestia confici possint, siquidem nocte leues melius stipulae, nocte arida prata tondentur .
reuse.text_english: The moon too, mistress of the nighttime, governs the lost and restored light in its monthly cycles, and illuminates the blind nights with the radiance of her brightness so that summer journeys and expeditions and labors may be carried out without toil and hardship, since by night the light loads are better, and by night the dry meadows are mown.
